```bash
`r config$remote$prompt` module load 2025
`r config$remote$prompt` module load `r config$remote$modules$python`
`r config$remote$prompt` python3 --version
```

```output
Python 3.13.5
```

`module load 2025` selects the 2025 site stack. `which python3` then prints a path in that stack. Read the path on the login node. This sample does not invent it.
